scope: candidate-local D1-TSUKIOKA-WAITING R3 Gate-1 person-space contract

canonicalReference.role: canonical adult customer canvas, camera scale, eye-line and seated body-proportion reference

camera.view: fixed straight-on customer camera from bartender/player side
camera.perspectiveRule: future adult customer characters share Tsukioka R3 front information perspective and may not introduce arbitrary camera angle or crop

eyeLine.method: manual center of both eyes/glasses on normalized candidate

shoulderLine.method: manual shoulder-axis estimate on normalized candidate

anatomicalSeatPlane.method: manual seated hip/seat-plane estimate; hidden by foreground counter in consumer view

apparentSeatedScaleRatio.relativeTo: Tsukioka R3 alpha-bbox height and overall person scale

ordinaryAdultAcceptance.allowedVariation: natural age, sex, build, posture and clothing differences that remain plausible beside Tsukioka
ordinaryAdultAcceptance.exceptions: miniature/giant scale, non-front perspective or crop outside these tolerances requires explicit character-design approval

forbiddenCharacterLayerPixels: furniture post, support, leg or footrest
floor, cast shadow or contact shadow
counter, table, food, drink or prop
room, background scene, UI, text or watermark
